notes.title: GALER Release date postponed until December 1st
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I am really sorry to be posting this, but unfortunately due to graphics issues, I will not be able to launch GALER yet. December 2016 is the VERY LATEST for the launch, but it could be sooner depending on how much work I get done over the next little while. 

Weekly updates will be included.

notes.title: GALER: Plague of heroes RELEASE DATE SET!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I am currently in the process of making Steam cards for my game, so that you may earn them and trade them accordingly. 

Due to this delay, I am setting my release date for August 31st, 2016.
